# seeks to know

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:seeksToKnow`](gmeow-seeksToKnow.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/seeksToKnow>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/inquiry`](../../slices/inquiry.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

An agent directs its inquiry at an epistemics resolution — pursuing the question specifically so as to [`gmeow:knowsThat`](gmeow-knowsThat.md) its answer: the goal-directed erotetic attitude that ties inquiry to the epistemics spine. Range OPEN, like [`gmeow:asks`](gmeow-asks.md). Non-functional. The aimed-at resolution is an epistemics acceptance, never a truth bit here.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md) -> `?`

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:seeksToKnow`](gmeow-seeksToKnow.md) from [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md) to `?` when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to record directed inquiry aimed at an epistemics resolution — the agent pursues the question specifically so as to come to [`gmeow:knowsThat`](gmeow-knowsThat.md) its answer, tying the open inquiry to the epistemics spine.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for undirected investigation (use [`gmeow:inquiresInto`](gmeow-inquiresInto.md)) or idle wondering (use [`gmeow:wondersWhether`](gmeow-wondersWhether.md)), and never read it as already knowing; the resolution it aims at is a separate [`gmeow:knowsThat`](gmeow-knowsThat.md) over an gmeow:answers-claim.

### How to use

- Point the agent at the question whose answer it seeks to know; mark the achieved resolution by an [`gmeow:knowsThat`](gmeow-knowsThat.md) over the accepted gmeow:answers-claim (the epistemics spine), and leave search and ranking of candidate answers to the solver layer ([Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)).

### Scope notes

- A question is OPEN for the agent until the agent [`gmeow:accepts`](gmeow-accepts.md) / [`gmeow:knowsThat`](gmeow-knowsThat.md) an gmeow:answers-claim for it; resolution REUSES the epistemics spine, so there is no new 'resolved' term ([Principle 6](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-6)). Reopening closes the prior accepted answer with [`gmeow:displayable`](gmeow-displayable.md) false ([Principle 10](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-10)), never deletion.
